predictions.registered: 2026-10-20 (this session, before Exp81 computation; patent/datasheet reading above is source extraction)
predictions.question: Exp71 ruled plasma/duoplasmatron-class sources insufficient (requirement B=4.06e4 A/m2/sr vs class anchors 10^1-10^2) and forced S1.1 to LMIS R&D class D. Was that a units/convention artifact? What does a first-principles derivation from the duoplasmatron factory current density give, and does a COTS plasma-class source (a) meet the brightness requirement with margin and (b) close Exp80's remaining BC3 when S1.1 drops D->C?

external_data.factory_current_density: US11289299B2: comparable factory specification for traditional duoplasmatron = 10 mA/cm2 extracted current density (=100 A/m2)
external_data.literature_brightness: space plasma mass spectroscopy text: duoplasmatron brightness ~10 A/cm2/sr (=1e5 A/m2/sr)
external_data.species_feed: PH3 (phosphine) documented as P feed gas across implanter patents (US4629930A, US6184532B1, EP1538655A2); PF3 also listed. PH3 is highly toxic - gas cabinet/scrubber required (standard implanter practice, cost note in summary).

method.derivation: Thermal-source axial brightness B = J * E / (pi * Ti) with J=100 A/m2, E=10 keV extraction, Ti swept 0.1/0.5/1.0 eV (stated assumption range for plasma ion temperature). Compare against Exp71 requirement 4.06e4 A/m2/sr and against the 1e5 literature anchor.
method.cost: Exp80 model at s=0.5 with two changes applied in BOTH golden and reference configs: S4.3 piezo stack C (Exp79) and S1.1 source D(1000)->C(100). BC3 predicate from predictions_exp80.json re-evaluated verbatim (golden cost_frac <= 0.50).
method.honesty: Brightness is necessary, not sufficient, for a 2 nm spot: energy spread/chromatic and lens aberrations (Exp66 equipment term) are separate budgets and are NOT re-derived here; the verdict is limited to the brightness line item Exp71 actually decided on.

predictions.success_rule: BD1 and BD3: conservative derived brightness >= 2x requirement AND recomputed golden cost_frac <= 0.50.
predictions: BD1 MARGIN: Derived duoplasmatron brightness at the conservative Ti = 1.0 eV end is at least 2x the Exp71 requirement 4.06e4 A/m2/sr.
BD2 CROSS-CHECK: The literature anchor 1e5 A/m2/sr lies within a factor 3 of the derived Ti=1.0 eV value.
BD3 BC3 CLOSED: Golden cost_frac with S1.1=C, S4.3=C, s=0.5 is at most 0.50.
BD4 THROUGHPUT KEPT: Golden configuration still delivers >=90% of the 10^6-beamlet reference throughput (model unchanged on the throughput side).
